name: vibecoding
description: Two separate systems in one repository: apps/content and apps/saas. Each has its own code, dependencies and lockfile; nothing is shared.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix apps/content && npm ci --prefix apps/saas
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/content && npm run build --prefix apps/saas
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/content && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/saas
